column2: Jhaveri S, Romanyk M, Glatt R, Satchidanand N. J Aging Phys Act. 2023;31(4):621-632. DOI:10.1123/japa.2022-0040
column3: Peer-reviewed community pilot; one-group pre/post, no control or randomization
column4: 10 adults with MCI; weekly 60-minute SMARTfit dual-task group sessions for 12 weeks at one YMCA
column5: Median TMT-A/B, several Stroop outcomes, and total SPPB improved; SPPB walking score did not significantly change
column6: Very small single-site sample, all participants African American, no comparator, no causal inference, no exercise-intensity measure, possible SPPB ceiling effect, Stroop interference-score caveat; authors call for larger RCTs
column7: Direct SMARTfit intervention evidence but preliminary. Report as within-group pilot observations only; no claims of causing improvements, preventing falls/dementia, or slowing MCI.
column8: NIH/NCATS and Health Foundation for Western and Central New York support; SMARTfit team provided programmatic and technical support per acknowledgments.
